# Agent size guide

How many agents one machine holds, measured on real GCP VMs (plan `agent-capacity-and-cost-gcp-2026-09-30`).
Agent counts come from `cost-model.ts`, and each row names the plan decision it was measured in. Prices are us-central1 list prices from `gcp-rails.ts` with a 120 GB disk and 730 h per month. Compute only: LLM tokens, egress and workspace data disks are not included.

- **active**: agents mid-turn at once that the machine held before commands slowed past the bar (D-019). `>=` means the run never saturated, so the real figure is higher.
- **own VM**: assigned agents ONE workspace can run on its own VM. It has to hold its own busy peak (on average 35% of agents are busy, and p99 is 1.3x that, D-038), and one agent slot goes to its Server.
- **pooled host**: assigned agents one host serves when many workspaces share a pool sized for the average. Servers are packed on their own hosts (see below).
- **mixed** = 50/50 Claude/Codex planning work, replayed. **heavy** = typecheck/test-heavy Papercusp engineering; its rows depend on the levers named in the source column.

## Smallest own VM for a workspace (mixed work, spot)

|---|---|---|
| 1 | e2-standard-4 | 71 |
| 5 | e2-standard-4 | 71 |
| 10 | e2-standard-4 | 71 |

| 25 | e2-standard-8 | 129 |
| 50 | e2-standard-8 | 129 |
| 100 | e2-custom-16-32768 | 206 |

A pool beats every row here: it is sized for the average, not for each workspace's own peak (see `cost-model.ts`, D-046).

## Server per workspace

| Server | host RAM GiB | idle cores | USD/month floor | USD/month packed | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| embed model in the Server process | 3.60 | 0.2 | 6.52 | 18 | D-045 |
| embed sidecar exits when idle (P-532) | 2.49 | 0.2 | 5.10 | 12 | D-045 + D-052 |

Floor = the Server's cores and RAM at e2 spot rates, reachable only with near-perfect packing. Packed = one e2-standard-16 spot host divided by the Servers it held.

## Hosted default

A new Papercusp-hosted workspace gets its own `e2-standard-4` VM, spot (read from `packages/operator-core/lib/auth/hosted/first-workspace.ts`).

- mixed: up to 15 assigned agents (8 active), 71 USD/month on spot (D-019).
- heavy: not measured on this shape.

## Pricing inputs

The Google cost a price has to cover each month, with a shared pool on spot:

- per workspace, its Server: 5.10-12 USD, floor to packed; Server variant: embed sidecar exits when idle (P-532); source: D-045 + D-052.
- per mixed agent: 0.90 USD on c4a-highcpu-16; source: D-027.
- per heavy agent: <=1.80 USD on e2-standard-16; source: D-040 (admission + shared tsc-service; saturation moved from n40 to >= n48).

The pricing model is the owner's decision and is not made yet. The default in use is a base fee per workspace plus a per-agent fee (D-046, D-052); metered busy agent-hours is the alternative. This guide commits no price.

To re-run the measurements behind these rows, see `README.md` in this directory.
